scientific_integrity: All general claims are proved symbolically. Prior unit and weight-equation results are acknowledged; no independent mathematical verification or bibliographic completeness is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to K-linear automorphisms and diagonal Euler derivations in positive characteristic; no classification of arbitrary locally finite derivations. Other modular-torus treatments may contain equivalent results. Finite tests are supporting evidence only.
title: Finite-characteristic Laurent Euler derivations: congruence isotropy and conjugacy orbits
